patch.value: Preset apply bypasses workspace settings history and leaves strict health failing

Packed pm-presets on published PM CLI 2026.9.28: initialize a disposable workspace, install the packed extension, run pm presets apply agent-workflow, then pm health --strict-exit --json. Apply reports success and diff --strict reports inSync=true, but health reports history_drift_workspace_state_mismatch:settings.json. applyPreset writes settings.json directly with fs.writeFileSync, bypassing the SDK audited singleton mutation. All preset entry points share this path.

Packed npm/Node and Bun acceptance apply a preset and pass strict PM health; settings changes appear in the verified workspace history; dry-run and failed apply leave both settings and history unchanged; merge and replace semantics remain correct; a missing audited mutation capability fails closed with actionable guidance.
